name: rhongomiant-durability-removed-no-return-without-mordred-champion
notes: Rhongomiant (clS3E0HrZL): the memory-return clause is "[Mordred Bonus]". With a non-Mordred champion (Tristan, Shadowdancer, whose UMBRA lineage enables the Exalted element) the weapon still loses its durability counter in the attack (3 -> 2) but no memory card is offered: all three memory cards stay in memory and the attack finishes with nothing pending.

rulesClauses: The memory-return trigger is a [Mordred Bonus]: no prompt without a Mordred champion.
